blocks.alt: Front view of a Cadillac Escalade showcasing a partial wrap

blocks.html:
Our designers transformed a Cadillac Escalade with a satin pink partial wrap, accenting the car’s lines with a bold pink finish. Here are the key highlights of this transformation.

Front view of a Cadillac Escalade displaying a partial wrap

Satin Pink Partial Wrap Project Details

We partnered with Vinyl Wrap Toronto for the installation.

Wrap Authority was used as a framework. They printed the design on a 1080 Series IJ 180 Printable Vinyl with Gloss Finish.

If you enjoy this blog, check out our other projects on partial wraps.

Contact us today to create your wrap with or without amazing stripes!
